subject: False occlusion alarms on three T2 pumps at Larkspur North

comments.author: Felix Arden
comments.body: We've had ⟦F23⟧three Tidewater T2 pumps at Larkspur North throwing occlusion alarms with no actual occlusion, all within the last couple of weeks this July⟦/F23⟧. Nursing is getting frustrated resetting them mid-infusion.

comments.author: Sam Okafor
comments.body: Thanks for flagging, Felix. Can you send me the serial numbers on those three units and roughly what time of day the alarms tend to trip? Want to rule out a line-set batch issue before we escalate to engineering.

comments.author: Felix Arden
comments.body: Serials are on their way over in a separate email to keep this ticket clean. Mostly happening on the overnight shift so far, no clear pattern on line-set lot numbers yet.

comments.author: Sam Okafor
comments.body: Got the serials, thanks. Opening a field engineering case to get eyes on the pumps directly rather than guessing over email. Will keep this ticket updated.

comments.author: Felix Arden
comments.body: Sounds good. Will keep an eye on it in the meantime and let you know if a fourth pump starts doing the same thing.
